security_audit.summary: Most Markdown backtick, schema URL, and scoped configuration-file findings are benign in context. Confirmed risk remains because this community skill instructs shell script execution, installs packages, mutates local project files, and extracts a bundled archive. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential theft, or intentional data exfiltration.

remediation.issue: Unpinned package installation and global pnpm installation
remediation.suggestion: Pin all package versions, avoid global installs, and document that package manager lifecycle scripts may execute during setup.

remediation.issue: Bundled tarball extraction during project setup
remediation.suggestion: Publish component source as plain text or validate archive paths and checksums before extraction.

remediation.issue: Shell scripts mutate local project files and remove build outputs
remediation.suggestion: Add working-directory guardrails, validate project names, and warn users before deleting dist or bundle.html.

content.value_statement: Complex interactive artifacts need more setup than a single HTML file provides. This skill scaffolds React, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, and bundling scripts for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
actual_capabilities: Creates a Vite React TypeScript project from a shell script.
Adds Tailwind CSS 3.4.1 and shadcn/ui theme configuration.
Installs Radix UI and shadcn component dependencies through pnpm.
Extracts bundled shadcn component source into the generated project.
Bundles a React app into one self-contained HTML artifact with Parcel.
limitations: Requires Node.js 18 or newer and a working npm or pnpm setup.
Runs package installation commands and needs network access to npm registries.
Targets complex React artifacts, not simple static HTML snippets.
Bundled archive contents should be reviewed before trusted use.

best_practices: Run scripts only in a clean workspace or temporary project directory.
Review generated package changes before installing dependencies in sensitive environments.
Use the bundled HTML output only after local review or testing for the requested workflow.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for small single-file pages that need no build system.
Do not run the scripts in repositories with unrelated uncommitted work.
Do not publish bundled output before checking package installs and generated files.

faq.question: Does this create a full React project?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses Vite, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui components.

faq.question: Can it produce one HTML file?
faq.answer: Yes. The bundle script uses Parcel and html-inline to generate a self-contained bundle.html file.

faq.question: Does it need network access?
faq.answer: Yes. The scripts install packages from npm-compatible registries through npm and pnpm.

faq.question: Is it suitable for simple artifacts?
faq.answer: Usually no. It is intended for complex artifacts with state, routing, or component libraries.

faq.question: Can I use it in Codex or Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should I review before use?
faq.answer: Review the shell scripts, package installs, archive contents, and generated files before using it in trusted projects.
